status.description: Whether the reading is finished or a draft.

code.description: LOINC code for what was measured: 8867-4 heart rate, 2708-6 SpO2, 80404-7 HRV.

subject.description: Who the reading belongs to: a patient ID or synthetic MRN.

effectiveDateTime.description: When the reading happened, in ISO 8601 UTC.

valueQuantity.description: The measured value, normalized to one canonical unit per code.

method.description: How HRV was calculated. Required for HRV records only.

metadata.description: Platform-specific fields kept from the source SDK. Fields a platform doesn't have are set to null.

uuid.description: The source SDK's unique identifier for this reading.

sourceRevision.description: Opaque, platform-specific description of the app/device that recorded the reading.

recordingMethod.description: How the reading was captured, if the platform can say.

lastModifiedTime.description: When the source record was last modified, in ISO 8601 UTC, if the platform can say.

sourceMetadata.description: Catch-all for any other platform-specific metadata not promoted to a named field above.
